vb_textbox.text: Begin with choosing the lighter mushrooms consecutively. When the payout for the light mushrooms begins to fall below 4 per turn, switch over to choosing the darker mushrooms until they too start providing less than 4 per turn. The payout seems to follow this kind of pattern the entire time. Alternate as necessary.eg. Lighter mushrooms are paying out between +9 and +4 = Keep picking lighter mushrooms.Lighter mushrooms are paying out between +3 and 0 = Immediately switch to choosing dark mushrooms.Note: Some of the "brightness" comparisons are difficult to distinguish. GREEN and RED shrooms are considered "dark" colours, even though they are quite bright compared to their counterparts.
